scripts.build: npm run build:site && npm run build:api
scripts.build:force: npm run build:site:force && npm run build:api
scripts.build:api: bash ../scripts/build-api-docs.sh --out website/dist/api && node scripts/check-api-bundle.mjs && python3 -B ../scripts/docs/check-api-links.py && npm run docs:api-references
scripts.api:dev: node scripts/stage-api-dev.mjs --clean && npm run build && node scripts/stage-api-dev.mjs
scripts.docs:architecture: node scripts/check-content-routes.mjs && node scripts/check-sidebar-icons.mjs && node --test scripts/content-routes.test.mjs
